paragraphs: Chapter 709
Episode 179. Unavoidable Trap (8)
While the magicians were gathering, Veradin gathered the researchers in the Coject.
"Dante, you won't have anything to do while I'm undoing the spell. So, take the researchers and go outside."
"There might be an attack when you are undoing the spell."

"That's possible. But would they risk attacking us after going through all the trouble of casting illusion magic just to buy time? Above all, we need to find a clue for the mass teleportation. It would be better to divide the manpower and do something since our hands are tied. We need to find other detention centers, not just clues for teleportation."
"Understood."
"When the illusion is undone, I'll signal you. Join us then. If there's an attack and we are scattered as you said, let's meet at the destination."
At the same time, the western border of Ricarten.
The actual force blocked Kinzelo.
"Commander… there are… many enemies."
"Where did they suddenly pop out from? We didn't see anything just a moment ago."
Bianca and Lanke said. The previously empty, dark sky was now full of the Chaos army, like a swarm of bees.
The number of battleships and Chaos Dragons was so large that it was hard to even estimate. Not only the front but also the sides and the rear were the same.
"Either it's a mass teleportation or an ambush using illusion magic. Probably the latter since no dimension gate opening was observed."
As Zephyrin predicted.
The Chaos Army had been building a siege line since Kinzelo entered Ricarten.
However, they couldn't notice it because the siege line was too broad, and they were deceived by illusion magic.
The officers' eyes turned to Zephyrin. Since Orgal hadn't returned to the fleet yet, the decision was up to Zephyrin.

"I will engage in battle with the goal of total annihilation, not breakthrough to the target area. Since this is the land of the evil god, if we leave any remnants, we will meet again. Prepare the entire fleet for battle. The gathering will be delayed, but there shouldn't be anyone in the alliance who didn't expect this level of variable."
"Understood, Zephyrin."
"Owl."
Zephyrin and Owl made eye contact.

"It would be better for Anonymous and Hidden Palace to step onto the ground. One for finding the detention center and securing information about mass teleportation, and one for rescuing Chagaun Jo. Especially now, there's a high chance of rescuing Jo when the enemies surrounding us are pushed back."
"I understand what you mean."

"Jo is a person we Kinzelo must definitely rescue. Of course, if the worst situation unfolds, we may have no choice but to abandon him, but I hope you'll take care not to let that happen. And Sir Berakt."
"Speak, High Commander Zephyrin."
"Sir, you should participate in the rescue of Jo with these people."
Berakt wanted to scream at me to save such a guy, but he barely swallowed his words.
"...Understood."
"I know Sir Berakt usually despises Sir Jo, but he is still the most important person in our grand cause. I hope you don't mess up the work because of emotions."
"Our Hidden Palace will infiltrate the destination ahead of others with some people taken out. Sir Owl, you might also need to take out some people from Anonymous."
Listening, Syris spoke up.
"I agree with the opinion of the Acting Chief of Hidden Palace. There is no better contingency than a blink when Jin is in danger."
Zephyrin nodded.
"Do so."
South Sea of Ricarten.
The fleet of Cosmos successfully exited the Steel Gate and deployed on the sea.

"Well, more severe teleportation spells have appeared since the world travel portal was closed. If the space transition used by the Red Owl is mass-produced, the Black Prince said he would share the benefits with us. I hope it's developed soon!"
Cosmos spoke, looking at the disappearing Steel Gate.
[It's noisy, you pirate. And the sharing of the technology Jin mentioned would be for Mary Runcandel, not you guys.]
"Ha-ha, our Knight of Ten is angry again. Let's get along well. To save people, we need to work well together."
Pirate King Cosmos skillfully handled the surprisingly coy young boy, Bale.
Although Bale grumbled, he didn't truly hate Cosmos.
"Cosmos. I think the reason Sir Bale is getting sensitive is because he feels a certain energy as soon as he gets here."
Valkas spoke in a low voice, looking at Bale.
He was sensing the dark aura unique to Paddler Runcandel, coming from the distant land. Of course, Bale was perceiving it more clearly than Valkas.
[As soon as we arrive, that bastard would be waiting... Orgal, didn't that kid betray us? He seemed to know in advance that we would be entering this way.]
"That won't be the case. Since there are only limited sea routes, they would have deployed forces in advance."
Under normal circumstances, Bale would be excited and eager to finish Paddler as soon as possible.
However, now there were too many people to protect. It was also not a situation where he could rule out that there were no other enemies besides Paddler.

"Heh, when we first met, he couldn't use his power at sea. Now, this is his territory. This snake-like bastard... But I'll show him we're on a different level. Valkas, you take a detour here and guard these people. I think it's better for me to go alone first. If there's any trouble, fire a flare immediately."
"Understood."
"Stay strong, Knight of Ten. And don't worry about us too much, we've already escaped from the army of the evil spirit once before. We're the immortal fleet of Cosmos, that's what!"
Bale's golden wings began to split the dark sky. Those left in the fleet turned their bows, watching his retreating figure.
Meanwhile, Jin and his party, who had exited the right steel gate, were facing unexpected darkness.
"This is strange darkness, isn't it? I can only see the person next to me, nothing else. Is this the center of Ricarten?"
As Sandra grabbed Jin's shoulder and spoke, Hedo took her hand off.
"It seems like a void, Miss. We don't know what will pop out from where, so we should not limit our colleagues' movements."
As Hedo said, as soon as the companions sensed the darkness, they kept their distance and guarded all around.
"I didn't hear about this from Orgal. It seems something changed while he was opening the dimension door."
Jin said so and wrapped the spirit power around Bradamante.
As soon as Jin cut the void's darkness as usual, he immediately realized that this place was not single-layered, and that the space 'reacts' to the attack.
Shagook-!
As soon as he cut through one layer of darkness, chaos drills poured out from all sides. The party's power was so high that it wasn't threatening, but if it continued, it would be a different story.
Testing a few more cuts into the void, drills sprang out each time.
'It feels like they added the characteristics of a boundary spell to the void. To play such a prank... it seems like an intention to buy time.'
The drills only reacted to Jin's spirit sword.
It was possible to penetrate one layer at a time with attacks other than the spirit sword, but there was an ineffable difference in efficiency.
Even when Hedo sincerely unfolded the realm of swordsmanship, it was not enough to make a clean cut.
It was a difference that originated not from the size of power, but from the uniqueness of the spirit power.
"If it's not a spirit sword, it would take a long time to break through."
"Everyone, back off. Especially be careful to protect non-combat personnel like Mr. Qwaul."
"Yes, my lord."
"Understood, young master!"
At Jin's words, the party backed off. And when he swung his sword, indeed, the drills only fell near Jin.
"Is the situation so bad that he has to buy time like this? Brother Diphus is unable to move, after all..."
If it were the usual Jin, he would have chosen to go ahead, adjusting more variables over time.
However, he now needed to break through quickly. With each passing moment here, the number of prisoners who could be saved would decrease, and Diphus could also recover.
Even if Diphus was already fully recovered and this dimension was merely being used as a means to confuse his party, breaking through was still the only option.
"I will break through quickly. The rest of you, follow me at a safe distance where the prongs won't reach, but don't lose sight of me."
"Understood."

"If he's buying time to recover, he'll surely try to tear us apart at some point. He must have formed this dimension because he finds it burdensome to face us alone. When that happens, even if you get separated from me, you must never separate from the agreed-upon group members."
Once the party entered the heart of Licarton, they planned to disperse at a certain point even without such a trap.
Valeria and Qwaul had to look for clues for teleportation, and the rest had to rescue the prisoners.
Only Jin and Hedo were scheduled to engage directly in combat with Diphus.
However, Jin decided to send Hedo to Qwaul.
"If Hedo is inevitably separated from me, please protect Qwaul. Until someone like Bale or Orgal comes to support, it seems safest for Hedo to take care of Qwaul."
"Got it."
Jin started moving forward, slashing through the dimension.
Innumerable prongs poured down, but not one even grazed Jin's robes.
When he had cut through about three hundred layers of the dimension, Jin started to feel like he was nearing the end.
The resistance coming from beyond the dimension was rapidly weakening.
Soon, after cutting through the last layer...
Suddenly, the strange darkness was swept away, revealing the sight of Licarton Castle standing tall like a black volcano, and...
Around it, trees as large as Licarton Castle itself were visible, exactly the same trees that the Empire and Zipple confirmed at the northern border.
Moreover, as soon as the party escaped from the dimension, the trees shook madly, dropping fruits containing prisoners all around.
Even for Jin, it was impossible not to be taken aback for a moment at the sight of such a terrible spectacle.
'My companions! I must check on my companions...!'
Thanks to being Jin, he swallowed a sigh and immediately looked back at his followers who had been following him. A curtain of energy that formed the dimension was separating Jin from his companions.
Of course, if the dimension trapped his companions, he could simply cut it open again with his sword.
But Jin couldn't swing his sword that way. The reason was a single great sword falling like lightning towards Jin's head.
"Welcome, little brother."
It was Diphus's great sword, Volgar.
